text:
Naxia is a genus of crabs in the family Majidae, containing the following species:

Naxia aries (H. Milne-Edwards, 1834)

Naxia aurita (Latreille, 1825)

Naxia spinosa (Hess, 1865)

Naxia tumida (Dana, 1851)
